about:
A Automotive Supply, Inc. operates from Lorton, Virginia, serving the automotive aftermarket with a focus on chemical products. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm distributes a line of brake parts cleaners, including a 50-state formula, an OTC-compliant non-chlorinated version, and an original non-chlorinated formula, each packaged in 12-can cases. It also supplies GP Petrogen fully synthetic 0W20 SP motor oil in 55-gallon drums. The business functions as a distributor rather than a manufacturer, stocking and shipping branded automotive chemicals.

Its customers include automotive repair shops, fleet maintenance operations, and industrial distributors that require compliant brake cleaning solvents and synthetic engine oils. The product mix targets professional technicians and resellers needing ready-to-ship inventory for routine vehicle service.

The company emphasizes availability of multiple brake cleaner formulations to meet varying regulatory requirements across states, alongside a high-volume synthetic motor oil offering for heavy-use applications.
